messages:
Owen Li: Hi team, quick BYOD/Q onboarding: I'm starting Mon and would like to use my personal ThinkPad for 3 days. It has Ubuntu 22.04 and TPM2. Can I enroll? Also worried about key backups: if I enable TPM-sealed LUKS, how does recovery work if TPM firmware resets? And phishsim is Wed 1 will pending enrollment make me miss it?

Priya (People Ops): Welcome Owen! :wave: Short: temporary BYOD ok with signed MOU. TPM OK but please export a LUKS header backup before you change firmware. PhishSim: pending enrollment won't immediately block access; finish the module ASAP.

IT-helpdesk: We can enroll your ThinkPad. Requirements: LUKS2 or LUKS1 with header backup, management agent, screen lock, SSO 2FA. If you seal keys to TPM we still ask for a header backup (`sudo cryptsetup luksHeaderBackup --header-backup-file header.img /dev/sda3`). Recovery: if TPM resets we can restore header and re-provision agent-wrapped keys via KMS after identity recheck.

Nia (Security): Policy notes: - BYOD must sign MOU. - TPM-sealed keys are preferred; when TPM resets we do an identity verification and rewrap keys into the agent vault. - VPN certs are short-lived and stored in agent vault; no plaintext certs on disk. PhishSim fail -> coaching + remedial module; repeated failures escalate.

Owen Li: Cool. Two quicks: 1) I run an encrypted external drive for backups  is that allowed? 2) How intrusive is the agent (privacy)?

IT-helpdesk: 1) External drives with corp data must be encrypted and only mounted when agent is active. We can apply an allowlist. 2) Agent enforces policies (remote-wipe, DLP hooks, cert escrow) and reports metadata/policy violations; it does NOT upload personal file contents.

Priya (People Ops): I'll DM the DocuSign BYOD MOU. @onboarding-bot please set Owen's security training due to Friday and open PhishSim window.

onboarding-bot: Training assigned: "Security Quickstart" due 2025-04-25. PhishSim window: 2025-04-22 -> 2025-04-29. Reminder: 2x.

Owen Li: Thanks 1 Ill backup header and sign MOU. Posting sanitized outputs before the enroll session: `uname -a`: Linux owen-laptop 5.15.0-70-generic x86_64; `lsblk -f`: sda3 crypto_LUKS a1b2c3d4. See you at the walkthrough.
